notes.title: Night Club Simulator : Party King is now Multiplayer CO-OP!
notes.notes:
[h2]🎉 [b]Big News for Nightclub Simulator![/b] 🎉[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Nightclub Simulator : Party King is now Multiplayer CO-OP[/b]! 🕹️✨[/p][p][/p][p]👥 [b]Team up with your friends[/b]
Host epic parties and manage your nightclub together. Solo mode was fun… but the real party starts with [b]co-op[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]🚀 Development is moving full steam ahead, and your [b]feedback & suggestions[/b] are more valuable than ever. We’re listening closely to the community as we polish the game. 💡[/p][p][/p][p]🎥 And that’s not all: a [b]brand new gameplay video[/b] is on the way soon — stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118351/3b0ea6c6d4e6082b19f625908fd4ff9b22c40e09.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 5,000 Wishlist Reached!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Thank you all for the incredible support![/b][/p][p]
We've officially hit 5,000 wishlists on Steam! This means the world to our small dev team, and it's a huge step toward making this game a reality. Stay tuned — more updates, sneak peeks, and surprises are on the way. Let's keep the party going! 🪩🥂[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118351/a1b10252379b0c0808062f5e3be5fd22476850f1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: NightClub Simulator 25 Last Updates
notes.notes:
Hello NightClub Patrons,

We are continuing to develop our game, NightClub Simulator 25, at full speed. Our core mechanics, such as DJing, Bartending, and working as a Bodyguard, are ready, and we are working hard to add many more mechanics.

Stay tuned for more updates and announcements about NightClub Simulator 25.
